issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בְּעֶצֶם תֻּמּוֹ' means 'in the very fullness/strength of his prosperity' (עֶצֶם = bone/strength/essence, תֻּמּוֹ = his completeness/prosperity), not 'in the completeness of his bones' (骸骨的完全). The Chinese renders 'עֶצֶם' as 'bones' (骸骨) rather than 'strength/essence', changing the meaning from dying in the midst of prosperity to dying in bodily completeness.
